questions.question: The roots of the equation 9(x + 9)² = 441 are :
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Divide 441 by 9 directly to get **49**.

Taking the **square root** of both sides: x + 9 = ±7.

Calculate the two values: x = −9 + 7 and x = −9 − 7.

The resulting roots are **−2** and **−16**.

**∴ The correct answer is −2, −16.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given Equation:** 9(x + 9)² = 441

**Method:** Solve the **quadratic equation** by isolating the squared term and taking square roots.

⇒ 9(x + 9)² = 441

⇒ (x + 9)² = 441 ÷ 9

⇒ (x + 9)² = 49

⇒ x + 9 = √49 or x + 9 = −√49

⇒ x + 9 = 7 or x + 9 = −7

⇒ x = 7 − 9 or x = −7 − 9

⇒ x = −2 or x = −16

**∴ The correct answer is −2, −16.**

**__Additional Information__**

Square Root Property

If u² = d, then u = ±√d. This property is used to solve equations of the form (x − h)² = k by taking the root of both sides.

Quadratic Formula

For any equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the roots can be found using x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)] ÷ 2a.

Nature of Roots

The discriminant D = b² − 4ac determines the nature. If D > 0 and a perfect square, roots are **real, rational, and unequal**.</p

questions.question: The perimeter of a square is equal to the perimeter of a rectangle of length 56 cm and breadth 42 cm. Find the perimeter of a semicircle (in cm) whose diameter is equal to the side of the square (Use π = {22over 7} )
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Perimeter of Rectangle** = 2 × (56 + 42) = 196 cm.

**Side of Square** = 196 ÷ 4 = 49 cm.

**Diameter** of **Semicircle** = 49 cm ⇒ **Radius** (r) = 24.5 cm.

**Perimeter of Semicircle** = (π + 2) × r = (22/7 + 2) × 24.5

Perimeter = (36/7) × 24.5 = 36 × 3.5 = 126 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 126 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of **Rectangle** (L) = 56 cm

Breadth of **Rectangle** (B) = 42 cm

**Perimeter of Square** = **Perimeter of Rectangle**

**Diameter** of **Semicircle** = **Side of Square**

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (L + B)

Perimeter of Square = 4 × Side (a)

Perimeter of Semicircle = πr + 2r (where r = radius)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eb9e305f9f61231aec039b35b02b6b90f299daa47cb4945a19b4c49ab0e7e0c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (56 + 42) = 2 × 98 = 196 cm

⇒ 4 × Side of Square = 196 cm

⇒ Side of Square (a) = 196 ÷ 4 = 49 cm

⇒ Diameter of Semicircle = 49 cm

⇒ Radius of Semicircle (r) = 49/2 = 24.5 cm

⇒ Perimeter of Semicircle = (π × r) + 2r

⇒ Perimeter = (22/7 × 24.5) + (2 × 24.5)

⇒ Perimeter = (22 × 3.5) + 49

⇒ Perimeter = 77 + 49 = 126 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 126 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Perimeter of a Semicircle

The total boundary of a semicircle includes the curved arc (πr) and the straight diameter (2r). Total Perimeter = πr + 2r.

Area of a Semicircle

The area is exactly half of the area of a full circle. Area = (1/2) × πr².

Square and Rectangle properties

For a square, Area = a² and Perimeter = 4a. For a rectangle, Area = L × B and Perimeter = 2(L + B).</p

questions.question: Which part of the Indian Constitution is related with the Panchayats?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IX**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panchayati Raj in India**

 
 
• In contrast to urban and suburban municipalities,** villages in rural India are governed locally through the Panchayati Raj **(Council of Five Officials) system.
 
• It comprises of the **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)**, which enable villages to practice self-government.
 
• Their mission is to **"strengthen social justice, advance economic growth, and implement Central and State Government Schemes**, including those 29 issues stated in the Eleventh Schedule." 
 
• The provision of the Indian Constitution that deals with Panchayats is **Part IX**.
 
• It indicates that there are** three levels of PRIs in states or Union Territories with more than two million residents**:
 
 
• the **Mandal Parishad, Block Samiti, or Panchayat Samiti** at the block level
 
• the **Gram Panchayats** at the village level and
 
• the **Zila Parishad** at the district level.
 
 
 
• There are only **two levels of PRIs** in states or Union Territories with **less than two million residents**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Every** five years**, members of the Panchayats at all levels are **elected**.
 
• **Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs)** must be represented in the Panchayats in an equal number to the general population.
 
• **Women** must hold at least **one-third of all seats and chairperson positions**, and in **some states, up to 50%** of all seats and chairperson positions.
 
• The **historical Panchayati raj system of the Indian subcontinent**, which is also present in Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Nepal, served as the basis for the **current Panchayati Raj system**, which was first implemented in India by the **73rd constitutional amendment in 1992**.
 
• The Panchayati Raj system is **currently exist in all states with the exception of Nagaland, Meghalaya, and Mizoram**, as well as in all **Union Territories with the exception of Delhi**.

questions.question: If the rate of interest is 20% per annum and interest is compounded half yearly, then in {3over 2} years a sum of ₹4000 will amount to :

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **half-yearly compounding**, Rate (R) = 20% ÷ 2 = **10%** and Time (n) = 1.5 × 2 = **3 periods**.

Use the **Multiplying Factor** for 10% over 3 periods: (1.1)³ = **1.331**.

Amount = Principal × Multiplying Factor = 4000 × 1.331.

Amount = 4 × 1331 = 5324.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5324.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = **₹4000**

Annual Rate (R) = **20%**

Time (T) = **3/2 years** (1.5 years)

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where r = rate per conversion period and n = number of periods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f83e25f2eeac6c468e1cc992608feba178c4668f97fa0d5fae8fb1cf778b9550.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Half-yearly Rate (r) = 20% ÷ 2 = **10%**

⇒ Number of half-years (n) = (3/2) × 2 = **3**

⇒ Amount (A) = 4000(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ A = 4000 × (11/10) × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ A = 4000 × (1331/1000)

⇒ A = 4 × 1331

⇒ A = 5324

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5324.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compounding Conversion Rules

For **half-yearly** compounding: Rate = R/2, Time = 2T. For **quarterly** compounding: Rate = R/4, Time = 4T.

Effective Interest Rate

The actual interest earned annually when compounding occurs more than once. For 10% per half-year, the effective annual rate = 10 + 10 + (10×10)/100 = **21%**.

Difference between SI and CI

Difference for 2 years (D₂) = P(r/100)². For 3 years (D₃) = P(r/100)² × (3 + r/100).

questions.question: A solid right circular cone is 11.2 cm high and the radius of its base is 2.8 cm. If the cone is melted and recast into a sphere, then what will be the diameter of the sphere?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a cone is melted and recast into a sphere, their volumes are equal: (4/3)πR³ = (1/3)πr²h

⇒ 4 × R³ = 2.8² × 11.2

⇒ R³ = (2.8 × 2.8 × 11.2) ÷ 4 = 2.8 × 2.8 × 2.8

⇒ Radius of sphere (R) = 2.8 cm

⇒ Diameter of sphere = 2 × R = 2 × 2.8 = 5.6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5.6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the cone (h) = 11.2 cm

Radius of the cone (r₁) = 2.8 cm

Let the radius of the sphere be r₂.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × r₁² × h

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r₂³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7128069d41a45c97aeb86fb84ffff7a7a8a359e28703d0eae1802ac041486891.png] 

**Calculations:**

Since the solid right circular cone is melted and recast into a sphere, their volumes remain unchanged.

⇒ Volume of Sphere = Volume of Cone

⇒ (4/3) × π × r₂³ = (1/3) × π × r₁² × h

⇒ 4 × r₂³ = (2.8)² × 11.2

⇒ 4 × r₂³ = 2.8 × 2.8 × 11.2

⇒ r₂³ = (2.8 × 2.8 × 11.2) ÷ 4

⇒ r₂³ = 2.8 × 2.8 × 2.8

⇒ r₂ = 2.8 cm

⇒ Diameter of the newly formed sphere = 2 × r₂

⇒ Diameter = 2 × 2.8 = 5.6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5.6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Melting and Recasting Principle

When any regular 3D shape is melted and recast into another shape, the overall volume remains constant, irrespective of changes in surface area.

Volume and Surface Area of a Cone

Volume = (1/3)πr²h | Curved Surface Area = πrl, where slant height l = √(r² + h²).

Volume and Surface Area of a Sphere

Volume = (4/3)πr³ | Total Surface Area = 4πr².

questions.question:
What will be the median of the given data?

1, 1.1, 2.3, 0.1, 0.9, 5, 3.9, 2.5, 4.2, 4.6
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange data in **ascending order**: 0.1, 0.9, 1, 1.1, 2.3, 2.5, 3.9, 4.2, 4.6, 5.

Total number of terms (n) = 10 (even).

Median = Average of the **middle two terms** (5th and 6th terms).

Median = (2.3 + 2.5) ÷ 2 = 4.8 ÷ 2 = 2.4.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Data set = {1, 1.1, 2.3, 0.1, 0.9, 5, 3.9, 2.5, 4.2, 4.6}

**Formula Used:**

For an **even number of observations (n)**, Median = [(n/2)th observation + (n/2 + 1)th observation] ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/212fce5a806eafa7b414536cd7afb83da90f64a00ab46b2515f9acc7cc2e1510.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arranging data in ascending order: 0.1, 0.9, 1, 1.1, 2.3, 2.5, 3.9, 4.2, 4.6, 5

⇒ Total observations **n = 10**

⇒ Position of the middle terms = 10 ÷ 2 = 5th and (10 ÷ 2 + 1) = 6th

⇒ 5th observation = 2.3

⇒ 6th observation = 2.5

⇒ Median = (2.3 + 2.5) ÷ 2

⇒ Median = 4.8 ÷ 2 = 2.4

Comparing the result with the given options, the value matches **Option (2)**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Odd Observations

If n is odd, the median is the value of the ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th observation after arranging the data in order.

Mean

The arithmetic average calculated by dividing the sum of all observations by the total count (n).

Mode

The observation that occurs most frequently in the data set.

Empirical Relationship

The relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.</p

questions.question: Find the least number which when divided by 11,12,13,14 and 15 leaves the remainder 2 in each case.

The **least number** is found using **LCM(11, 12, 13, 14, 15) + Remainder**.

Checking divisibility of (Option − 2) by 11 and 15.

60062 − 2 = 60060, which is divisible by both 11 and 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 60062.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisors are 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15. The constant **remainder** is 2.

**Formula Used:** Required Number = LCM(Divisors) + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88e63e3c1329df82862fb3e346ac3a6cd804c519e18ed64ddda7149a9a69792b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of divisors:

⇒ 11 = 11¹

⇒ 12 = 2² × 3¹

⇒ 13 = 13¹

⇒ 14 = 2¹ × 7¹

⇒ 15 = 3¹ × 5¹

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3¹ × 5¹ × 7¹ × 11¹ × 13¹

⇒ LCM = 4 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 11 × 13 = 60060

⇒ Required Number = 60060 + 2 = 60062

**∴ The correct answer is 60062.**

LCM Method for Remainders

When a number leaves the same remainder 'r' for different divisors, the number is of the form [LCM(divisors) × k] + r.

HCF for Remainders

To find the **greatest number** that divides x, y, and z leaving remainders a, b, and c, calculate HCF((x−a), (y−b), (z−c)).

Common Difference Case

If the difference between divisor and remainder is constant (d = divisor − remainder), the least number is LCM(divisors) − d.</p

questions.question: The numbers 4, 6, 10, x, 20, 24, 32 are arranged in ascending order. Find the value of x if their mean and their median are equal.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **n = 7** terms, the **Median** is the 4th term, which is **x**.

Sum of remaining terms = 4 + 6 + 10 + 20 + 24 + 32 = 96.

If **Mean = Median = x**, then **Total Sum = 7 × x**.

96 + x = 7x ⇒ 6x = 96 ⇒ x = 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers in **ascending order** are 4, 6, 10, x, 20, 24, 32. Total terms (n) = 7.

**Formula Used:**

**Mean** = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

**Median** (for odd n) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd573b27161ec4dad0b790810f2cc0800d2765475b761c1e64bed8a5ff3b0440.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Median = ((7 + 1) ÷ 2)th term = 4th term

⇒ Median = **x**

⇒ Mean = (4 + 6 + 10 + x + 20 + 24 + 32) ÷ 7

⇒ Mean = (96 + x) ÷ 7

⇒ According to the question, Mean = Median

⇒ (96 + x) ÷ 7 = x

⇒ 96 + x = 7x

⇒ 6x = 96

⇒ x = 96 ÷ 6

⇒ x = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median of a Data Set

For a set of **n** observations arranged in order, if **n is even**, the median is the average of (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

Empirical Relationship

The relationship between the three measures of central tendency is given by: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Property of Mean

The sum of **deviations** of all observations from their arithmetic mean is always **zero**.</p

questions.question: The income of A is 25% less than the income of B whose income is 40% more than that of C. The income of C is 20% less than that of D. By what percent is the income of A more than the income of C?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Income A : Income B** = 75 : 100 = 3 : 4

Ratio of **Income B : Income C** = 140 : 100 = 7 : 5

Combined Ratio **A : C** = (3 × 7) : (4 × 5) = 21 : 20

**Percentage Increase** = ((21 − 20) ÷ 20) × 100 = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income of **A** = 25% less than **B**

Income of **B** = 40% more than **C**

Income of **C** = 20% less than **D**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e24c41fb71c3bc14ef3a1bacaffc338c37b4004fd286091553857b8a69ee6a5.png] 

**Step-by-step Calculation:**

⇒ Let the **Income of C** = 100

⇒ **Income of B** = 100 + (40% of 100) = 100 + 40 = 140

⇒ **Income of A** = 140 − (25% of 140) = 140 − (1/4 × 140)

⇒ **Income of A** = 140 − 35 = 105

⇒ Difference between **Income A** and **Income C** = 105 − 100 = 5

⇒ **Percentage Increase** = (Difference ÷ Income of C) × 100

⇒ **Percentage Increase** = (5 ÷ 100) × 100 = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Comparison Formula

To find how much percent x is more than y, use: Percentage = ((x − y) ÷ y) × 100.

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by a% and then by b%, the net change is (a + b + (ab ÷ 100))%. Note that a or b are negative for a decrease.

Fractional Equivalents

25% = 1/4 | 40% = 2/5 | 20% = 1/5. Using fractions simplifies complex calculations in ratio-based problems.</p

questions.question: The volume of a right circular cylinder is 1792π cm³ and its radius is 16 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm²) of the cylinder?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The relationship between **Volume (V)**, **Radius (r)**, and **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of a cylinder is: **CSA = 2V ÷ r**.

⇒ CSA = (2 × 1792π) ÷ 16

⇒ CSA = 3584π ÷ 16

⇒ CSA = 224π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 224π cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Volume (V)** = 1792π cm³

**Radius (r)** = 16 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3c18d51bb1b8ffe0d2b5acabd3156a12203236ed5719ab3acea57232ede2585.png] 

**Step 1: Find the height (h)**

⇒ 1792π = π × (16)² × h

⇒ 1792 = 256 × h

⇒ h = 1792 ÷ 256

⇒ h = 7 cm

**Step 2: Find the Curved Surface Area (CSA)**

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × r × h

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × 16 × 7

⇒ CSA = 32 × 7 × π

⇒ CSA = 224π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 224π cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The **Total Surface Area** includes the curved area and the area of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of a Cylinder

The **Volume** represents the space occupied: Volume = Area of Base × Height = πr²h.

Base Area and Perimeter

The **Area of the base** is πr² and the **Circumference** (perimeter of the base) is 2πr.</p

questions.question: If 28957.5 ÷ 268.125 = 108, then 289.575 ÷ 2681.25 is equal to :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ 28957.5 ÷ 268.125 = 108

**CONCEPT**** USED:**

Shifting of decimal to left = on dividing by10,100,1000 and so on, move the decimal point to the left as many places as there are 0s.

Shifting of decimal to right = when you multiply a decimal by a power of 10,move the decimal place to the right as many places as there are 0s.

**CALCULATIONS :**

28957.5 ÷ 268.125 =108

⇒ to shift two places of decimal in numerator, divide by 100 =289.575

⇒ multiply by 10 in denominator to shift decimal right by one place =2681.25

Now, L.H.S= 289.575 ÷ 2681.25 

⇒ Hence, the same thing should be done to R.H.S as well i.e. divide the numerator by 100 and multiply the denominator by 10 i.e. (1/100)÷10 =1/1000

⇒108/1000=0.108

⇒ 289.575 ÷2681.25 = 0.108.

**∴ The new value is 0.108.**

questions.question: What is the definition of fiscal deficit?

options.text: Expected increase in inflation, and expected appreciation of currency
Rise in inflation inside the Indian economy
Excess of total expenditure over total receipts excluding debt
Expected reduction in inflation, and expected currency appreciation

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**excess of total expenditure over total receipts excluding debt.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The difference between the total income and expenditure of the government is called fiscal deficit.**
 
• This shows how much borrowing will be required by the government to run its business.
 
• Borrowings are not included in the calculation of total revenue.
 
• **Fiscal deficit is usually due to decrease in revenue or excessive increase in capital expenditure.**
 
• Capital expenditure is incurred on long-term assets such as factories, construction of buildings and other development works.
 
• The fiscal deficit is usually met by borrowing from the central bank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The word deficit is the exact opposite of surplus**, because when the government spends more than its income, then that excess expenditure is called fiscal deficit and if the government receives more income than it spends, then That surplus means profit is considered.
 
• The government receives mainly from taxes and its businesses, but this income does not include borrowings from the government.
 
• Government spending more than income is considered the biggest reason for fiscal deficit.
